coder.text: Here is the problem. Every session writes a transcript, and this is the module that writes it. The opening line records when the session started, but nothing ever records when it ended.

The end of a session goes through this finish function, which only adds the recap. And the extension only calls it when there is a recap, so a session ended without one leaves no ending at all. So today, reading a transcript, you cannot tell whether the session took five minutes or an hour.
Sure, more simply. A transcript is like a log of the session, and it has a start time written at the top. But it never gets an end time written at the bottom.
This little function is the one that writes the end of the log. Right now it only writes the summary, nothing about time. So we fix it here, by having it also write how long the session took.

I will start in this finish function. It will take the time the session started, work out how long it lasted, and write an end line with the finish time and the length. I will also make it work when there is no recap, so every session gets an ending.

First, a small helper that turns a length of time into words you would say out loud, like under a minute, twelve minutes, or one hour five minutes. I made it its own function so it can be tested on its own.
And the finish function now takes the start time. It writes the recap only if there is one, and then always ends with a line saying when the session ended and how long it took.
The other half is in the extension. When a session begins, it creates the transcript here, but it does not remember the time. I will have it note the start time right at this point.
Here the start time is now remembered when the session begins.

And here, when the session ends, the extension now always closes the transcript and hands it the start time. Before, it skipped this whenever there was no recap. I check that the session is still active, so a transcript can never be closed twice.
Got it, I will skim from here. The end of the session now always gets closed with its length. Last step is a quick test, then I will wrap up.
